xna-type.name: GamerServicesNotAvailableException
xna-type.summary: Thrown if the gamer services system cannot be successfully initialized.
xna-type.remarks: The following are likely causes for this exception. If the current game uses the XNA Framework Redistributable . This file does not include Games for Windows – LIVE functionality. If another Games for Windows – LIVE title is running already. Important Games for Windows - LIVE is not available to finished games. This functionality is not included in the redistributable version of the XNA Framework, and a game that attempts to use these components without XNA Game Studio installed will result in a GamerServicesNotAvailableException .

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of GamerServicesNotAvailableException with the specified error message and the inner exception.

parameters.parameter: A message that describes the error.
The inner exception related to this exception.

constructor.summary: This constructor is available only when developing for Windows.
constructor.syntax: protected GamerServicesNotAvailableException ( SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context )

parameters.parameter: Describes the gamer services being accessed when the exception occurred.
Describes the stream where the exception occurred.
